newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: RADIO HEADLINES AT MIDDAY - MARCH 25.
newsitem.headline: RADIO HEADLINES AT MIDDAY - MARCH 25.

text.p: The following stories were reported on Lithuania's radio M1 Plus at midday on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- An international panel commissioned by the EBRD said that the Ignalina nuclear power plant is not safe and should be closed until the necessary safety upgrades are made.
- To prevent the Baltic states from joining NATO, Russia will delay border talks with them, according to an analysis by Danish intelligence.
- Belarus customs officials confiscated a video tape made by Russia's Independent TV (NTV) on the Lithuanian- Belarus border on Monday night.
